ruleDefinitions.name: Delete All Scheduled Tasks
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of schtasks with the delete flag and the asterisk symbol to delete all tasks from the schedule of the local computer, including tasks scheduled by other users.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/delete\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tn\\ \\*.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/f.*")))
